findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: xcut_find_hooks, xcut_audit_content, xcut_check_niche, xcut_list_canvases, xcut_get_canvas, xcut_list_calendar, xcut_search_viral, xcut_get_job, xcut_import_profile, xcut_add_note, xcut_get_content · Private data: xcut_write_content, xcut_run_playbook · Public sink: xcut_find_hooks, xcut_write_caption, xcut_repurpose_content, xcut_list_canvases, xcut_add_to_calendar, xcut_update_calendar_post, xcut_delete_calendar_post, xcut_find_outliers, xcut_profile_analytics, xcut_import_post, xcut_import_website, xcut_import_profile, xcut_get_content, xcut_generate_image · Destructive: xcut_get_playbook, xcut_delete_memory, xcut_delete_calendar_post, xcut_search_viral, xcut_run_playbook.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
